verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies, but no evidence item documents a Windows capability for acting on many items at once. The only automation-related item (windows-probe-4) shows that an official CLI, PowerShell, is documented. That is a general scripting building block, not documented bulk-operation support. Snap groups are window organization, an adjacent feature that does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
